evidence.detail: rs/n/c/ak builds exact root 48999 and fully populates its six-child surface; no other project class depends on this builder except the interface registry.
The only three content actions are the exact strings 'Edgeville teleport', 'Home teleport' and 'Bounty teleport', bound to widgets 48997, 48996 and 48995.

The remaining widgets are presentation-only: one background/sprite and a standard 'Close Window' control. The class contains no construction-room names, build actions, object placement, room state or other construction semantics.

Although the button sprites are loaded from the path 'construction/sprite' and the close icon from 'LOGS/ICON', those paths are only presentation resources here; every user-visible action on root 48999 is a teleport shortcut.
